ProviderProbeRequest.description:
Check a provider configuration that has not been saved yet.

The editor can test a brand-new provider before creating it. When the key is
already stored, the client sends only ``provider_id`` so the secret never
leaves the server again.

WordStateCounts.title: WordStateCounts
WordStateCounts.description:
Where the learner's words sit in the memory curve right now.

A mastered word has left the schedule on purpose, so it is reported with
the words under review rather than as a fifth bucket.
